when required MCPs fail to initialize

head_commit.message:
fix: include DELETE permission in Windows sandbox ACL for file moves

The `add_allow_ace` function was granting FILE_GENERIC_READ |
FILE_GENERIC_WRITE | FILE_GENERIC_EXECUTE but missing DELETE and
FILE_DELETE_CHILD. On Windows, Move-Item (MoveFileEx) requires the
DELETE access right on the source file. With WRITE_RESTRICTED tokens,
the restricted SID check failed for DELETE, causing "Access to the
path is denied" errors on every file move/rename in the sandbox.

Use the existing WRITE_ALLOW_MASK constant (which includes DELETE and
FILE_DELETE_CHILD) to match what the elevated setup path already uses
via ensure_allow_write_aces.

Also fix the early-return check to verify the full WRITE_ALLOW_MASK
is present, so stale ACEs missing DELETE get upgraded correctly.
